title: AbbVie’s Q3 beat should keep ‘train rolling’ as company eyes bolt-on deals

title: RIFTT: Robust Identification of Fusion genes in Tumor Transcriptomes.
snippet: Fusion genes serve as crucial biomarkers for cancer diagnosis, prognosis, and therapy, yet many detection tools lead to high false-positive rates and poor consensus. title: TRACER: Twin-contrastive learning for fine-grained and rare spatial domain identification in spatial transcriptomics.
snippet: Fine-grained and rare spatial domains are difficult to identify in spatial transcriptomics because they contain few spots, show subtle transcriptional differences, and are strongly influenced by neighboring regions.
